t.name: Semiahmoo Greenway
t.description: Greenway preserving portions of the historic Semiahmoo Trail, an early route between the Fraser River and Semiahmoo Bay. Used since the 1850s and later a wagon road, it now provides a scenic walking and cycling corridor.

t.name: The Trans Canada Trail
t.description: This is for the Pedestrian Only sections of the TCT. The bicycle sections of the Trans Canada Trail will usually be close by OR on a parallel path.
